decision: Retain R1435-R1438 pending. Owner serial disambiguates reused Win16 aliases. Retired, cancel-started, cancel-active and completed distinguish teardown, late completion and reentrant completion. Per-task cleanup is called from wsext.c; native-handle lookup is called only from wsdata.c before its definition. Moving that entire helper before its caller removes the header declaration but increases the combined zero-context point count from 23 to 24. Discarded the unpublished trial.
